description_en: Before using large models or applications in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, create an API key as an authentication credential
description_zh: 使用阿里云百炼的大模型或应用前，请先创建 API Key 作为鉴权凭证
kebab_example: aliyun modelstudio create-api-key --workspace-id ws-8af73c50f5596193 --description test --auth '{"modelAccessScope":{"accessibleModels":["qwen3.6-plus"],"allowAllModels":false},"accessIps":["192.168.1.0/24"],"type":"Custom"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApiKey

parameters.description_en:
The workspace ID.
> 
> - If you leave this parameter empty, the API key is automatically assigned to the default workspace.
parameters.description_zh:
业务空间 ID。
> 
> - 若不填写时，创建的API Key会自动归属于默认业务空间。

fields.description_en:
The IP access whitelist.

> 
> - When you set custom permissions and leave the IP access whitelist empty, the server sets the default values to IPv4 (0.0.0.0/0) and IPv6 (::/0), which allows all traffic.
fields.description_zh:
IP访问白名单。

> 
> - 当自定义权限范围时，若未填写IP访问白名单，服务端会默认设置为：IPv4 （0.0.0.0/0）和 IPv6 （::/0），代表全部放通。
